events.name: A Job Offer
events.intro: A recruiter in a plain jacket falls into step beside you. "We have noticed you. We notice useful people. There is a uniform, a code name and a desk, and nobody will ask you for a reason. Decline, and we will never have met."

success.text: A uniform is folded into your arms. You are somebody else now, on the inside.
The recruiter nods once and is gone.

events.name: A Small Job for the Team
events.intro: An officer hands you a sealed envelope without looking up. "Errand. Nothing to do with the plan. Do it well and people will notice."

success.text: It is done by evening, and nobody says thank you, which is how you know.

choices.label: Refuse to your officer's face (-4 reputation, never below your band)

success.text: The officer's pen stops. Then it starts again.

choices.label: Slip the errand's target a warning (a small mercy)

success.text: Somebody in the city sleeps better tonight.
